jobs.title: [diag] bm-c 内存占用诊断（只读）
jobs.cmd:
python -c "import subprocess,os;os.makedirs('cph4/fleet/reports',exist_ok=True);m=subprocess.run(['powershell','-NoProfile','-Command','(Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).FreePhysicalMemory'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip();p=subprocess.run(['powershell','-NoProfile','-Command','Get-Process ^| Sort-Object WS -Descending ^| Select-Object -First 12 Name,@{n='GB';e={[math]::Round($_.WS/1GB,2)}} ^| Format-Table -AutoSize ^| Out-String -Width 200'],capture_output=True,text=True);o=subprocess.run(['ollama','ps'],capture_output=True,text=True);open('cph4/fleet/reports/bm-c-mem.md','w',encoding='utf-8').write('# bm-c 内存诊断

- 空闲(KB): '+m+'

## Top 进程
```
'+p.stdout[:3000]+'
```

## ollama ps (rc='+str(o.returncode)+')
```
'+(o.stdout or o.stderr)[:1500]+'
```
')"

jobs.title: [rescue] bm-c 卸常驻模型回收内存
jobs.cmd:
python -c "import subprocess,os,re;os.makedirs('cph4/fleet/reports',exist_ok=True);g=lambda:subprocess.run(['powershell','-NoProfile','-Command','(Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).FreePhysicalMemory'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip();b=g();p=subprocess.run(['ollama','ps'],capture_output=True,text=True);names=[l.split()[0] for l in (p.stdout or '').splitlines()[1:] if l.strip() and not l.startswith('NAME')];stopped=[];
for n in names:
 subprocess.run(['ollama','stop',n],capture_output=True,text=True);stopped.append(n)
open('cph4/fleet/reports/bm-c-rescue.md','w',encoding='utf-8').write('# bm-c 内存回收

- 空闲(KB) before: '+b+'
- 模型: '+str(names)+'
- 已卸: '+str(stopped)+'
- 空闲(KB) after: '+g()+'
- ollama rc: '+str(p.returncode)+'
')"
